sloka: समृद्ध अर्थस्य सिद्धार्था मुदित अमल वर्णिनी ।आर्यस्य त्वम् विशालाक्षि भार्या भव यवीयसी ॥३-१८-१०॥
transliteration: samṛddha arthasya siddhārthā mudita amala varṇinī ।āryasya tvam viśālākṣi bhāryā bhava yavīyasī ॥3-18-10॥

translations.english: O largeeyed one, you have a clear complexion. You may become the younger wife of my master who is lord of great wealth. And live a happy, fulfilled life.
